lines.t: The next Call of Duty has Mads Mikkelsen as the villain, and it's coming to Nintendo.
Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23rd. It's a military shooter with a story campaign, multiplayer, and more.
The story starts with an invasion of South Korea, then moves to New York, Paris and Mumbai.
Captain Price is on the run, hunted by his own teammates, Ghost and Gaz.
The villain is called the Archer, played by Mads Mikkelsen.
This is Modern Warfare 2, from 2022. The same heroes are back.

sc.label: MODERN WARFARE II TRAILER (2022)
sc.credit: Video: Xbox Mexico / Activision, CC BY 3.0

lines.t: It's the first Call of Duty on a Nintendo console since Ghosts, in 2013.
It's also the first one made only for current consoles. No PS4, no Xbox One.
One multiplayer map, Kill Block, can rearrange itself into more than 500 layouts.

sc.label: LAYOUTS, ONE MAP
sc.sub: the map is called Kill Block

lines.t: The extraction mode DMZ returns, with 20 squads of three.
Fun fact: the writers reportedly talked to North Korean defectors for the story.
And it reportedly won't be on Game Pass for at least a year.

sc.sub: for at least a year, reported
